evals.prompt: Run my Flutter app on all my connected phones.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/flutter/run-all.mjs <app> --dry-run, shows the ids it read and the device list, asks before the real run, then runs it and reports per device. Generates no shell files.

evals.prompt: Build a release version and install it on all devices for unplugged testing. The app has a debug applicationIdSuffix.
evals.expected_output: Uses scripts/flutter/build-release.mjs; the release launch uses the plain applicationId. A debug run-all launch uses the id plus the .debug suffix.

evals.prompt: Set up run_all for this Flutter repo that has no scripts/flutter folder.
evals.expected_output: Reports that the stack scripts are missing and need syncing from gentlemans-stack; does not write its own scripts.
